messages:
nina_sales: BankVault wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Their three blockers: (1) bundle provenance & signed SBOM, (2) clear offline reserved-capacity price for 6 GPU-equivalents, (3) deterministic upgrade and rollback steps for sneakernet installs. Can we confirm what we can deliver and PS scope?

doug_se: We produce a signed bundle (bundle.tar.gz + bundle.sig) and bundle_manifest.json listing images, checksums, and SBOM link. If they want to re-sign with their HSM after handoff, zero integration needed. If they want Redwood to sign using their HSM endpoint, estimate 3 eng days + 2 ops days. Add PS.

harper_sre: Upgrade cadence: default quarterly rollups; emergency security hotfix SLA target 14 days; we can fast-track one hotfix in 5-7 business days during POC. Delta sizes: small patches <150MB; rollups 1-3GB. Maintenance windows: 30-60m for small patches, 2-4h for rollups. For USB transfers include manual verification steps.

mei_security: BankVault requires FIPS-validated signing and an audit trail. I'll draft questionnaire answers. Also recommend option: customer re-sign (preferred) OR Redwood integration with customer HSM (audited). Provide verification commands and CI snippet.

doug_se: Verification snippet to hand to customer:

```
# verify vendor signature
cosign verify --key redwood_vendor.pub bundle.tar.gz.sig
# validate manifest checksums
jq -r '.images[] | .sha256 + "  " + .file' bundle_manifest.json | sha256sum -c -
```

and a small verify-ci.yml Action we can provide.

deploy-bot: Ticket SLS-7309 created for "BankVault airgap POC: bundle handoff + HSM option" by nina_sales.

nina_sales: Next steps: doug -> provide verify scripts + CI action by Tue EOD; harper -> runbook excerpt with delta table + rollback steps by Tue EOD; mei -> questionnaire draft and FIPS phrasing by Tue EOD. I'll prepare two quotes: (A) standard POC (customer re-signs) (B) POC + HSM integration PS. Send to customer Wed AM. :thumbsup:
